items.t: Mastercard (MA) Opens Singapore Innovation Centre With 250 New Specialist Roles
items.sum: Mastercard (NYSE:MA) has opened its largest Asia Pacific Innovation Centre in Singapore to support regional digital commerce and AI work. The Singapore facility is set to create more than 250 specialist roles across AI, cybersecurity, and data-focused functions. items.t: Can Mastercard's Singapore Innovation Hub Accelerate AI-Led Growth?
items.sum: MA's Singapore innovation hub aims to accelerate AI-driven payments, cybersecurity and agentic commerce, unlocking growth opportunities across Asia-Pacific.
